item.title: Law
item.description: # Description htmLawed 1.2.5 on port 80 of this lab is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE). We can gain access to the Linux server as the user ‘www-data’. We have write access to a cleanup script, which is executed by root. We can use this to escalate our privileges. # Skills Learned CVE Exploitation GLPI htmlawed (CVE-2022-35914) Privilege Escalation via cronjob # Solution # Finding the vulnerability autorecon shows ports 22 and 80 are open.
